records.question: How long does Spotify hold on to my personal information?
records.text:
According to Section 6 of the Spotify Privacy Policy, Spotify keeps personal data for as long as the user chooses, unless one of the limited purposes described applies. [Spotify – 6. Data retention] 

Specifically, personal data is deleted immediately after the Age Check, and certain data is retained until the user removes it or until Spotify's legitimate and essential business purposes are fulfilled. [Spotify – 6. Data retention] 

For example, streaming history is kept for the life of an account, and personal data is deleted after a specific period of time, such as 90 days for data input as part of search queries. [Spotify – 6. Data retention]

records.question: Will Spotify give my money back if I cancel partway through a subscription period?

records.question: What can Pinterest do with the pictures I upload?
records.text:
According to [Pinterest – 1. The Service], Pinterest "shows you things we think will be relevant, interesting and personal to you based on your onsite and offsite activity." This implies that Pinterest can use the pictures you upload to personalize your experience on the platform, but it does not explicitly state what Pinterest can do with the pictures.

However, [Pinterest – a. Posting User Content] states that Pinterest "shows you content and ads on and off Pinterest that are relevant to you" based on your interests. This suggests that Pinterest may use the pictures you upload, as well as other information about you, to serve you content and ads that are relevant to you.

It's worth noting that [Pinterest – 6. Third party links, sites, and services] states that Pinterest "may contain links to third party websites, advertisers, services, software components, special offers or other events or activities that are not owned or controlled by us." This implies that Pinterest may use the pictures you upload to serve ads or other content from third-party sources.

Overall, while the exact extent of what Pinterest can do with the pictures you upload is not explicitly stated, it appears that Pinterest may use them to personalize your experience on the platform and serve you relevant content and ads.
cited_labels: [Pinterest – 6. Third party links, sites, and services]

records.question: Does Pinterest use the websites I visit to show me ads?
records.text: According to passage [Pinterest – We also use your information to personalize the ads you see], Pinterest uses the information it collects to "identify your interests based on your onsite and offsite activities, as well as by using information we receive from ad partners or other third parties." This suggests that Pinterest may use information from the websites you visit to show you ads, but it does not explicitly state that it does so.
cited_labels: [Pinterest – We also use your information to personalize the ads you see]
